# Organization

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Organization`](gmeow-Organization.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Organization>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/entities`](../../slices/entities.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A structured group of agents — a company, institution, association, or governmental body — able to act as a single agent.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Organization`](gmeow-Organization.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a formally structured collective that acts as one agent — a company, institution, association, or governmental body — when its internal structure and capacity to bear responsibility matter.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for an informal, structure-free collection of agents (use [`gmeow:Group`](gmeow-Group.md) instead) and for an individual human (use [`gmeow:Person`](gmeow-Person.md)); [`Organization`](gmeow-Organization.md) is disjoint with [`Person`](gmeow-Person.md) and [`SoftwareAgent`](gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md).

### How to use

- Type the body as [`gmeow:Organization`](gmeow-Organization.md), name it through [`gmeow:hasOrganizationName`](../properties/gmeow-hasOrganizationName.md) / [`gmeow:OrganizationName`](gmeow-OrganizationName.md) (names module) rather than the flat [`gmeow:name`](../properties/gmeow-name.md) literal, and model departments and membership through the part/whole spine ([`gmeow:subOrganizationOf`](../properties/gmeow-subOrganizationOf.md)) and role relators.

### Examples

- ex:blackcat a [`gmeow:Organization`](gmeow-Organization.md); [`gmeow:hasOrganizationName`](../properties/gmeow-hasOrganizationName.md) ex:blackcatLegalName.
